capabilities: Create and edit campaign elements such as adventures, chapters, events, NPCs, factions and scenes
Link elements with typed relationships (bidirectional, unidirectional, parent, child)
Plan sessions and scenes and take notes during play
Define custom attributes, tasks and element templates
Generate NPC attributes with ChatGPT or a local Ollama server
disambiguation: Not a rules engine or character-sheet tool; it manages campaign narrative elements and explicitly says it is not a replacement for character sheets.
extras: Metadata is stored in a code block rather than frontmatter. The README warns to back up the vault before upgrading from v3, since the plugin will not work after the update until the vault is upgraded. ChatGPT usage incurs per-token API costs paid by the user.
motivation: The author built it out of the need for a central repository for campaign ideas, notes, plotlines, and player character decisions.
problem: Obsidian has no structured way to plan and run TTRPG campaigns, leaving game masters with campaign notes scattered across multiple platforms and notebooks.

relations.evidence: with RPG Manager's ChatGPT integration, this dream becomes a reality
An open source alternative to ChatGPT exists, called Ollama
use BRAT to revert to v3.4.5

summary: Tabletop RPG campaign manager that organizes campaigns, adventures, sessions, NPCs and locations as linked notes with an embedded editing UI.
